title: fix(plugin-email): saving mail provider "None (log only)" stops delivery instead of keeping the live SMTP transport
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuACdPWFJTLDcTrByFCHLzqb)_

Fixes #25450

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## What was wrong
Setup → Email offers the provider `log` as **"None (log only — no real delivery)"**. When `log` was saved, `applyMailSettings` (`packages/plugins/plugin-email/src/email-plugin.ts`) returned without swapping the transport. It logged "transport unchanged — messages are logged and recorded in sys_email, never delivered". After a boot with SMTP, every message kept going out over SMTP. The live-status banner (landed with #25448) truthfully said SMTP was live. "Send test email" sent a real message and answered "Sent test email to …". The page label and the log line both said nothing was delivered.

## Measurement: was "transport unchanged" deliberate? No. Shape (A).
- `git log -S"transport unchanged"` finds the line's origin in `fc9b204fe8` ("Add global scope + reactive settings client"). There `smtp` and `log` shared ONE no-op branch, with the comment "No SMTP transport ships in core; settings-only edits become a no-op for transport". For both providers, nothing could be swapped in.
- `41c3b48f1d` shipped `SmtpTransport` (ADR-0012) and split the branch. `smtp` got a real swap. `log` kept the no-op, and the docstring describing it says "`provider = 'log'` keeps the LogTransport". That line assumes the live transport is already the LogTransport. Neither commit, nor ADR-0012, names a boot-built transport (`OS_EMAIL_SMTP_*` / `providerOptions`) or a host-supplied one that a saved `log` must not replace.
- The code already decides precedence the other way. A saved SMTP host replaces a boot-built or host-supplied transport, and so does a saved Resend/Postmark key. The only place the boot SMTP is kept is the `smtp`-with-no-host branch. That is the out-of-the-box namespace, where the page has stated nothing. Env precedence over the page lives one layer up, in the settings env lock (`OS_MAIL_*`, `SettingsService.get`), not in keeping the transport.
- The manifest's own contract text (`service-settings/src/manifests/mail.manifest.ts`, the `PROVIDER_OPTIONS` comment) says of `log`: "the label says so, the runtime honours it". After this PR, that is true.

So nothing deliberate protects the old transport, and this PR takes **(A)**. A saved `log` installs the `LogTransport` and replaces whatever was live, the same way every other selected provider does. A host-supplied transport is not exempt. The settings page already replaces it for every other provider, so an exemption for `log` alone would bring back the mismatch between the label and what the transport does.

## The change
- `applyMailSettings`, `provider === 'log'`: if the live transport is not already a `LogTransport`, install a new `LogTransport` and drop the `liveSmtp` handle. This matches the Resend/Postmark branch: the old SMTP pool is not closed under a possible in-flight send.
- The info line now says what happened, and names the transport it replaced: `the LogTransport now replaces the previous live transport (was: "Mail is delivered through SMTP (host:port)") — messages are logged and recorded in sys_email, never delivered.` When nothing delivered before, it says `the LogTransport stays live — …`.
- Docstring updated.
- Landing: the file the claim names. `live-transport-status.ts` and the manifest/translations are unchanged. The banner and the label were already true statements; the transport was what disagreed with them.

### Why `Metadata-protocol: none`
This does change what a saved value DOES: a saved `log` now stops mail. But `mail.provider` is a settings value that an administrator stores in `sys_setting` through Setup. It is not metadata an author writes, and the change adds, narrows or re-means no key, value or type in the metadata protocol. The changeset carries the operator-facing consequence and the one-line remedy.

## Tests
New `packages/plugins/plugin-email/src/mail-log-provider.pin.test.ts`. Each pin reads all four answers from one save: the live transport and `isConfigured()`; the page statement (`registerLiveStatus`); the re-apply's log line; and the "Send test email" answer, with `nodemailer.sendMail` never called.
- After a boot with SMTP **saved on the page**, saving `log` gives: LogTransport, banner "No mail leaves this machine", a line naming the replaced `SMTP (smtp.saved.test:587)`, and Send test `ok: false` / `warning`.
- After a boot with SMTP **built from the boot options** (`OS_EMAIL_SMTP_*` reaches the plugin as `providerOptions`): the same.
- After a boot with a **host-supplied** transport: the same. The host transport is not called.
- A **restart** with `log` stored and SMTP in the boot options boots onto the LogTransport.
- **CONTROL**, a boot with no SMTP: the boot LogTransport stays live (same instance), the banner warns, the line says "stays live", and Send test answers `ok: false`.

Fixture re-judged: `email-plugin.queue-delivery.test.ts` used a stored `provider: 'log'` with a host transport, which relied on exactly the "transport unchanged" behaviour this PR removes. Its default namespace is now the out-of-the-box one: `smtp` at its manifest default, no host. That branch keeps the harness transport, as before.

Runs (head `fa561813a8`):
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-email test` gives Test Files 38 passed (38), Tests 685 passed (685).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-email typecheck` gives exit 0 (`tsc --noEmit` plus `check:test-typecheck: OK`).

**Ablation** (head `fa561813a8`, through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`): the anchor `this.service.setTransport(new LogTransport(ctx.logger));` was replaced by a no-op. The tool reported "ok mutation landed: anchor 1 -> 0, blob 6e5d43794b5a -> 0a9522b85240". The pin went RED, with Tests 4 failed | 1 passed (5): all four SMTP/host legs failed and the CONTROL held. The restore reported "ok restored: blob == HEAD (6e5d43794b5a) and `git diff HEAD` is empty". The test imports `./email-plugin.js` from `src`, so no `dist` leg applies.

## Gates
`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` at `fa561813a8` derives 67 commands. All 67 ran locally and exited 0. `--ran`, with an exit code recorded for each, says: "67 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 67 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero …)".
- `check:engine-double-contract` was red on the first pass, because the new pin's fake engine declared an `update()`. The fake now answers reads only (`persist: false`), and the gate is green.
- The CI-only families (Test Core, Build Core, type-check lanes, artifact rosters) are read from this PR's check-runs.

## Acceptance notes
- Found while measuring, and not changed here: with **"None" picked on the form but not saved**, "Send test email" still sends through the live SMTP and answers "Sent test email to admin@… (id=…)". The handler's `provider === 'log'` path tests the live service rather than the form's choice. A throwaway probe at `fa561813a8` (not committed) showed `ok: true`, with `sendMail` called once. Reported to the seat as a separate finding.
- When the transport is swapped, the previous SMTP pool is not closed. This holds on every swap branch, not only `log`. It is pre-existing, and nothing in this PR changes it.
